description: Search a vendor's catalog so the offer can name exact products, then follow the how_to_ask field of the result. A store catalog returns products with a handle, price and collections: ask with ask.items [{ product_handle, quantity }]. A campaign catalog returns eligible variants with a variant_id and approved_combinations with a recipe_id: ask with ask.items [{ variant_id, quantity }] or ask.recipe_id. A quote identifies the exact items and quantities it covers.

collection.description: Optional collection handle to filter by.

name: haggl_search_catalog

approved_combinations.description: Campaign catalog: approved combinations with a recipe_id for ask.recipe_id.

code.description: Present only when the call failed: a machine-readable error code, e.g. quote_uncertain or rate_limited.

collections.description: Store catalog: collections to filter by.

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

how_to_ask.description: How to name these products in haggl_submit_offer.

products.description: Store catalog: matching products with handle, title, price and collections.

recovery.description: When the outcome is uncertain: the tool and session_id to read before retrying.

retry_after_seconds.description: When rate limited: seconds to wait before retrying.

retryable.description: Whether the same call may be retried.

total_matches.description: Store catalog: number of matching products.

variants.description: Campaign catalog: eligible variants with a variant_id.
